permissions.purpose: Leak lists your webhook endpoints to check they exist, are enabled, and listen for the events your billing depends on.
permissions.name: Read-only audit of webhook endpoints. Leak never creates, modifies, or deletes endpoints.

permissions.purpose: Leak reads recent delivery failures so it can point you at the exact events and endpoints that need attention.
permissions.name: Read-only scan of event delivery failures in the last 15 days.

permissions.purpose: Leak spots past_due and unpaid subscriptions whose customers may still hold access in your app.
permissions.name: Read-only scan of past_due and unpaid subscriptions.

permissions.purpose: Leak spots open invoices left behind by failed payment attempts.
permissions.name: Read-only scan of open invoices.
